summary: Additive attachment-rule successor combining the v6 row model (adjustment_rows, subtractive tie_out) with the v4 value-checked required_answer, plus three additive completeness/applicability constructs: a family-occupancy applicability trigger generalizing v3/v4 family_nonempty to a set of families alongside an optional threshold trigger; completeness.required_closures naming source families whose closure the attachment vouches for; and branch_requirements[].asserts_families_empty declaring that a branch's answer implies named families are empty. No published version is edited. Proposed on paper by Track 0; the schema file is written in Track 1.
